player_prompt.intro:
Wezi Player {player_id} mu Tic Tac Toe Yaikulu.
Pa turn yako, unaweza kuweka 'X' au 'O' mu sqeu iliyopewa.
Unawina kwa kupanga marki tatu (X au O) mstari.
Unaweza kushinda na alama zote mbili.
Chagua chaguo lako kwa kutumia fomu '[X 4]' ili kuweka X katikati.

invalid_move.invalid_cell: Nambala ya selo yosagwira ntchito: {cell}. Iyenera kukhala pakati pa 0 ndi 8.
invalid_move.already_occupied: Kusuntha kosaloledwa. selo {cell} liri kale ndi munthu wina.

game_action.placed: Mchezaji {player_id} wakaika alama yao ({mark}) mu seli {cell}
